verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that a page titled 'Canny API Reference' exists. Nothing indicates it is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no machine-readable spec behind an interactive explorer. A static reference page is adjacent to this story, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
